reviews.t: TSA-approved clear quart bag - sturdy and surprisingly roomy!
reviews.x: This clear bag quart bag is terrific for travel, and is surprisingly roomy and sturdy! My family used these during a recent trip to Europe - they zip open and closed easily, are made of heavy plastic, and the gusset design allows one to fit a large amount of travel-sized bottles! Much better than a zip-lock sandwich bag. Highly recommend, especially for anyone who wants to use only carry-on luggage instead of checking their bags. reviews.t: Dump the sandwich baggies
reviews.x: These are perfect!!  I took one through security with no problems at all.  I loaded the second in my checked luggage.  If you do have items that may leak, wrap them in their own cheap little baggie so they don’t get all over everything else.  I’m thinking of getting more to organize all of my cables, chargers, adapters, travel docs, etc.  I love them

reviews.t: Put your travel liquids all in one place
reviews.x: The bags are secure and because of their width, hold mush more than a large zip-lock bag. You can pack many liquids into these TSA approved bags, as long as they are under 3.3 ounces. Many small toiletries are specifically holding their tubes and bottles under that amount to make for easily travel.  I am flying to Europe for three weeks this summer and Delta Airlines sent an email to pull out all your liquids when you go through the line. The bag makes it easy to pull out or your carry on to sep

reviews.t: Worth it!
reviews.x: GREAT bags! Very flexible and easy to use. Soft material that stands up pretty well when loading stuff in it.

reviews.t: Don't be fooled!
reviews.x: So when I opened the package, I thought it was so small, no way I can fit my things in here. That is definitely not true. I got all my things in and had room for more. I will use this for all my traveling now. I only had it for a day, so I do not know how it will endure travel, but if I have any issues with durability I will update my review.

reviews.t: I really like this travel bag!
reviews.x: Nice bag to carry some of the travel size items I needed for my flight.  No problems through checkpoint. Because it has a flat bottom, it worked better for me than a Ziploc bag. Even tested it in the rain and the bag stayed dry inside.  To have a small carrying handle would be nice.  It worked for me as described.

reviews.t: Don't waste your money
reviews.x: I bought two of these. The second trip I went on the seam opened up on it. I noticed when my liquids went flying out when going through security. I'm a very frequent traveler and need something that works. Going back to a good old standard zip lock bag.

reviews.t: Zipper ripped away from the plastic while I was filling it.
reviews.x: Nice size, but zipper ripped away from the plastic while I was filling it. I am concerned about liquids leaking on other items in my carry on, so for this trip will go back to the bag. Very disappointed in the quality.

reviews.t: They actually fell kind of like "silk" plastic
reviews.x: WOW - THIS IS EXACTLY WHAT I WAS LOOKING FOR. They actually fell kind of like "silk" plastic...VERY PLEASANT TO TOUCH!!!

reviews.t: Worked well. The squared off sides mean they hold ...
reviews.x: Worked well.  The squared off sides mean they hold much more than a ziplock bag, and TSA didn't give them a second glance.

reviews.t: Doesn’t hold up
reviews.x: Very cheaply made. It only took one weekend trip to tear!

reviews.t: Not study enough for frequent travel
reviews.x: I purchased a set of two of these in January 2018, and just tossed them after a trip where both of them split at the seams. If you're not a frequent traveler, these are fine, but we use them at least 1x a month for anything from a weekend trip to a 3 week trip to Europe. They replaced a set of REI bags that had one too many liquid leaks that didn't get cleaned in time (oops), which lasted us 7 years. These made it just over a quarter of that time.  Ours split next to the seams, usually because s

reviews.t: Great for carry on travelling
reviews.x: Great value for 2 approved TSA pre approved toiletry bags. These are great to have when taking carry ons and need to pull out liquids in a see thru bag. Makes going thru security lines that much easy and efficient. Highly recommend getting a couple for people who travel frequently and want to speed up the process.

reviews.t: Seems durable enough. I just used them on an ...
reviews.x: Seems durable enough.  I just used them on an 8 day trip, taking things in and out with no problems - did not zip & unzip each time, however didn't have any concerns.  They defiantly hold more then qt ziplock bags.  I'm TSA PreCheck, so did not have to take them out to show going through security.

reviews.t: Perfect and fits a lot
reviews.x: I love these bags.  Perfect for 3-1-1 carry on compliant toiletries.  Fits more than a quart ziplock b/c it has depth and isn't flat.  Soft, flexible plastic and super clear.  Easy to fit a lot and you can easily see what's inside.  Also great for carrying charging cords, earphone, etc.

reviews.t: A Bit Flimsy
reviews.x: These are definitely flimsier than I expected but they were one of the least expensive options I found, so I guess I got what I paid for. They've worked just fine for several trips, no issues with TSA, and although I have to be gentle with them they have not actually broken.

reviews.t: Size is great, but plastic is thin
reviews.x: I just used this bag on a trip and the size was just right.  I did notice that there is now a small tear in the bag, so the plastic is not that thick or strong.  I'm not sure what could have caused the tear, but as long as it doesn't rip open, the bag will work for me.

reviews.t: great quality
reviews.x: These are really nice -- its a soft pliable plastic, so it will reduce in size if the bag isn't filled, and conforms nicely to the space in your suitcase.  I also got another brand that is stiffer and not nearly as nice.  I'll be getting more of these

reviews.t: Good. Material looses its clear see-through quickly.
reviews.x: Used daily to carry tech gear and small personal items between different bags. One star off for the material - the clear material developed opaque smokey marks all over from friction with items inside and outside. Still 75% see through.

reviews.t: Nice bags. I will definitely use
reviews.x: Nice bags.  I will definitely use. Bag is water resistant with a zipper that is surprisingly tight, but it's not water proof. Probably very protective in rain but not so protective submerged. Spills in bag may not be contained.

reviews.t: So Good We Ordered More
reviews.x: After using ziplock bags for years, we discovered these TSA Approved bags. They are terrific! They are durable, hold more, and make it easy to find things inside. We are giving them as gifts to friends we travel with.

reviews.t: the zipper came apart after 2 uses
reviews.x: I loved this little bag and was happy to not use the disposable bags. However on my return trip the zipper came detached from the bag.  It is glued on not sewn so it was not meant for multiple uses.  disappointed.

reviews.t: All Clear TSA Bags Are NOT Created Equal!
reviews.x: These toiletry bags made by Grade Code are really superior to other clear plastic TSA type bags.  They are much wider and easier to take stuff in and out.  I cannot recommend these bags enough.

reviews.t: Great!!
reviews.x: Had a little issue with one bag but the company quickly sent me a replacement. They were quick to respond and correct the problem. The bag itself is a great size and holds the essentials.

reviews.t: Travel bag
reviews.x: Used this bag for a weekend get away and was carrying on my suitcase. it worked great got lots of items in there with small 1 oz bottles. It has a lot more room that a quart size baggie.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the bags for holding more than a standard quart ziplock thanks to their depth and gusset design.
Many customers report the bags work well for TSA security checkpoints with no problems.
Several reviewers describe the plastic as soft, flexible, and pleasant to touch.
A notable number of reviewers report durability problems, with seams splitting or zippers tearing away from the plastic.
Some reviewers note the bags are fine for occasional use but not sturdy enough for frequent travel.
